ةﻮﻄﺨﺑ ةﻮﻄﺧ ..ﻚﺘﯾاﺮﻗ ﻲﻓPARAGRAPHS · UNIT 1 See More of Tunis on Foot
Come along with us on our marvellous walking tour to the medina of TUNIS; we will
take you through the numerous alleys full of craft shops, souvenirs, colours and secrets
to some of the most important buildings.
The “Great Mosque” or the “Zitouna Mosque”, which was built in the 19th century, while
the mosque today serves mainly as a house of prayer. It was also a house of higher
learning in the 1950s.
Dar El Bey or Bey's Palace will be our next destination. You'll be amazed by the
architecture and decoration, which reflect many different styles and periods.
Finally, you'll rest your feet in one of the most splendid cafés inside the medina, “Café
M'Rabet”; the interior hasn't changed for at least a hundred years.
It's a cool rescue when the summer heat makes walking the streets of the souks almost
unbearable. The café is built over the tombs of three holy men, and the restaurant on
top of the café is considered as one of the most exclusive places in all of Tunis. If you
visit it in the afternoon or evening, expect belly dancing or live music together with the
food.
